Introduction
• The Iris Dataset is a popular dataset used in machine learning to classify 
iris flowers. 
• It contains 150 samples with four features: sepal length, sepal width, 
petal length, and petal width. 
• Based on these measurements, the flowers are classified into three 
species: Iris setosa, Iris versicolor, and Iris virginica.

Objective of the Project
• To build a machine learning model using the Iris Dataset.
• To analyze flower measurements such as sepal length, sepal width, petal    
length, and petal width.
• To train the model so it can learn patterns from the dataset.
• To predict the type of iris flower like Iris setosa, Iris versicolor, or Iris 
virginica based on input measurements.

KNN Algorithm
• KNN is a supervised learning algorithm.
• It classifies data based on nearest neighbors
• Uses distance metrics like Euclidean distance.
SVM Algorithm
• SVM is a powerful classification algorithm.
• It finds the best boundary (hyperplane) separating classes.
• Works well for high-dimensional data.
